items.title: Ernest 'Punch' Miller Interview, 1960-08-23
items.q: He was a straight reader, but he played out there with P. Ron.

ctx.x: He was a straight reader, but he played out there with P. Ron. And Kemba was a straight reader, but he could... He could...

But all them boys was out there in the field like me, all them got off, I ain't kidding, every one of them. Every one of them. Now this Louis Demand, he didn't get off, but he always had good music. What about a guy like Kaza? Kaza played with Sackton. Clarinet and Sackton. Clarinet and Sackton, yeah, he played good, but I never did wake with Kaza. Was he a get off man?
